controls.title: Information to be provided (privacy notice)
controls.description: Provide data subjects with transparent information about processing purposes at collection.

controls.title: Lawfulness and consent
controls.description: Establish and record a lawful basis; where consent is used it must be freely given and recorded.

controls.title: Right to withdraw consent
controls.description: It must be as easy to withdraw consent as to give it.

controls.title: Data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure)
controls.description: Operate a mechanism to fulfil access, rectification, erasure and portability requests.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures (encryption, access control).

controls.title: Personal data breach notification
controls.description: Detect, document, and notify personal data breaches to the supervisory authority within 72 hours.

controls.title: Storage limitation and retention
controls.description: Personal data is kept no longer than necessary for the purposes for which it is processed.

controls.title: Processor governance
controls.description: Engage processors only under a binding contract with sufficient guarantees.

controls.title: Cross-border transfer governance
controls.description: Transfers of personal data to third countries have an adequate legal transfer mechanism.
